MS NOW host Joe Scarborough mocked Elon Musk for wasting nearly $500 million on GOP candidates in the midterms — and then painting himself as a “moderate” in a blatant attempt to distance himself from President Donald Trump and his MAGA movement.

“Hey Elon, I’m a Baptist,” Scarborough said Thursday. “I’m a Baptist. We play [the hymn] ‘Just as I Am’ and ... if we have to play 16 verses until you come down front and confess your sins before God Almighty, we will accept you into the fold. Amen.”

Musk quietly became the biggest known donor in this year’s midterms, reportedly spending $474 million on Republican organizations and PACs to save GOP majorities in Congress. The tech trillionaire’s efforts failed, and Democrats won control of both the House and Senate.

Democrats have notably warned the Tesla and SpaceX CEO of potential investigations into him and his companies, which receive billions in federal contracts, over his controversial time as head of the so-called Department of Government Efficiency (DOGE) last year.

While the temporary organization was created with the stated aim of slashing wasteful public spending, Musk helped dismantle key agencies, including the Department of Education, and has been accused of using DOGE to gut regulatory entities that were investigating his firms.

Musk openly warned lawmakers and pundits last month who were pushing for those investigations that he “will find out who is really pulling the strings and come for them” — and claimed a Democratic sweep would mean the “end” of American democracy.

The tech CEO tried hard on Wednesday during an interview to rebrand himself as a “moderate,” telling journalist Andrew Ross Sorkin that he is “not MAGA,” has no “blind adherence” to the movement and regrets his “pretty foolish” spending in the midterms.

“It is a rebrand ... and you know, never mind with the eugenics and the Hitler salute — he’s a moderate now!” Scarborough joked about Musk, who has urged people to procreate amid declining birth rates, made a Nazi-like gesture last year and called himself “Dark MAGA.”

Scarborough made Musk a cheeky offer to return to the country’s good graces.

“If you ... would like to confess your sins against American democracy and you … may have spent hundreds of millions of dollars trying to destroy American democracy and this morning you’re feeling bad about it, we accept you into the fold,” the “Morning Joe” host joked.

He noted, “Now, of course, the Oversight Committee will probably run you over coals.”

Scarborough continued pouring salt on the wound by joking that if America ran like a Baptist church, its deacons wouldn’t invite Musk to the picnic immediately, and he “might have to wait a couple of weeks” before he can play on their softball team.

Scarborough mockingly concluded, “But from here to there, you’ve taken the first step.”
